en: 2 Chronicles 3

p.src: 1  Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

ja: その後、ソロモンはエルサレムのモリヤ
であり、ダビデが指定したエブス
en: Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
u.src: 1  Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

p.src: 2  He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

en: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
u.src: 2  He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

p.src: 3  Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

ja: の寸法によるキュビト で、
en: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.
u.src: 3  Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

ja: 3:3 一キュビトは約46センチメートル、または約18インチである。
en: 3:3 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 4  The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

en: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
u.src: 4  The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

p.src: 5  He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.

ja: 広間の天井をイトスギ材で
り、さらに純金をかぶせ、そこにヤシの
en: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
u.src: 5  He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.

p.src: 6  He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.

en: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.
u.src: 6  He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.

p.src: 7  He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

en: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.
u.src: 7  He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

p.src: 8  He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

ja: タラント に上る純金をかぶせた。
en: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
u.src: 8  He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

ja: 3:8 一タラントは約30キログラム、または約66ポンドである。六百タラントは約18メートルトンである。
en: 3:8 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 600 talents is about 18 metric tons

p.src: 9  The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

ja: シェケル であった。
en: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
u.src: 9  The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

ja: 3:9 一シェケルは約10グラム、あるいは約0.35オンスである。五十シェケルは約0.5キログラム、または約1.1ポンドである。
en: 3:9 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 50 shekels was about 0.5 kilograms or about 16 Troy ounces.

p.src: 10  In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.

ja: り、それに金をかぶせた。
en: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.
u.src: 10  In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.

p.src: 11  The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

ja: キュビトで、もう一方のケルビムの
en: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
u.src: 11  The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

p.src: 12  The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

ja: キュビトで、家の壁に届いており、もう一つの翼も五キュビトで、一方のケルビムの
en: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
u.src: 12  The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

p.src: 13  The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

ja: これらのケルビムの翼は
キュビトに広がっていた。ケルビムは
en: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
u.src: 13  The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

p.src: 14  He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

ja: を造り、それにケルビムの模様を施した。
en: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.
u.src: 14  He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

p.src: 15  Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

ja: に高さ三十五キュビトの
en: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
u.src: 15  Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

p.src: 16  He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

ja: のザクロを造り、それを
en: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
u.src: 16  He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

p.src: 17  He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

ja: にしてその柱を立てた。
en: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
u.src: 17  He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
